sharedRules.name: Amphibious
sharedRules.description: Vehicle can move on impassable water at at half speed by means of an Advance order. Cannot make any other action whilst moving over water. A vehicle that is immobilised whilst in the water is sunk.

sharedRules.name: Armoured all round
sharedRules.description: No modifiers apply for penetration when shooting at sides, rear or from above.

sharedRules.name: Bicycles
sharedRules.description: Bicycle mounted infantry follow the same rules as infantry, except when moving entirely on a road, in which case they double their RUN move to 24".  (This move cannot be used to Assault). In addition, the first time they receive any order other than RUN, or if they receive a pinning marker, they dismount and abandon their bycycles for the rest of the game.

sharedRules.name: Cavalry
sharedRules.description: Cavalry can dismount and fight on foot. A cavalry unit moves at 9” with Advance order and 18” with a Run order. While mounted, cavalry units have the Tough Fighters rule. Cavalry are allowed to roll 2D6 when they make their regroup move. Cavalry can react with a escape move.

sharedRules.name: Co-axial Weapon
sharedRules.description: A co-axial can be fired instead of the vehicle's main weapon, but not at the same time, the player must choose either to fire the main gun or it's co-axial weapon.

sharedRules.name: Command Vehicle
sharedRules.description: The command vehicle adds a morale bonus of +1 to itself and to any other friendly armoured vehicle within 12” (but no Snap to action extra dice).

sharedRules.name: Crew
sharedRules.description: The unit number of crewman is indicaded inside the brackets.

sharedRules.name: Crew Carried MMG
sharedRules.description: 360° arc of fire, the crew can fire the MMG or the main gun, but not both at the same time.

sharedRules.name: Dual Direction Steering
sharedRules.description: The vehicle can reverse at their Run rate.

sharedRules.name: Fanatics
sharedRules.description:
When a fanatic unit loses half of its numbers from enemy fire it does not take a morale check. In close quarters fighting continue fighting until the fanatic unit wins, is completely wiped out or is defeated. Fanatic units with at least two men left are not routed and destroyed when they have a number of pin
markers equal to their morale value.

sharedRules.name: Fixed
sharedRules.description:
When ordered to Fire, fixed weapons can only target an enemy unit that lies at least partially within their front arc. When ordered to Advance, fixed weapons do not move from their position, but can instead be rotated on
the spot to face any direction, and can then fire suffering the normal –1 to hit.

sharedRules.name: Flak
sharedRules.description: Roll a D6 for each flak unit. To successfully hold their fire inexperienced units must roll a 4+, regular units a 3+, and veteran units a 2+. Units that do not manage to hold their fire will shoot at the incoming aircraft as if it were an enemy. Shooting against aircraft always hit on 5 or 6, the only to hit modifier that applies are pin marker. For HE apply rules for units inside buildings. If the aircraft suffers 3 or more hist it has been shot down.

sharedRules.name: Flame-throwing Vehicle
sharedRules.description: When rolling on the damage effects chart against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

sharedRules.name: Flamethrower
sharedRules.description: Flamethrowers never suffer the to-hit penalties for cover, if the target is Down and for long range. D6 hits for man portable flamethrowers, D6+1 hits for vehicle mounted ones. Ignores cover bonuses. Ignores the Gun Shield rule. Ignores the Extra Protection rule in buildings. Flamethrowers always hits vehicles top armour. The target receive D3+1 pin markers for being hit by a flamethrower. After the hits check for morale.

sharedRules.name: Green
sharedRules.description: Green Units are Inexperienced. When the unit suffers its first casualty roll a die: on a roll of 1 the unit suffers an additional D6 Pin Markers and goes Down; on a roll of 2,3,4 nothing happens; on a roll of 5 or 6 the unit is immediately uprated to Regular for the rest of the battle.

sharedRules.name: Gun Shield
sharedRules.description: If fired at from the front, crew is +1 to damage

sharedRules.name: HE (1")
sharedRules.description: Use the appropriate template to determine how many models in the unit have been hit. Hits against infantry that reacts going Down are halved rounding down. If able to fire both HE and Anti-tank, when firing from Ambush, must specify which round is loaded. D2 Pin Markers, +1 PEN, Hits vs targets in buildings D3

sharedRules.name: HE (2")
sharedRules.description: Use the appropriate template to determine how many models in the unit have been hit. Hits against infantry that reacts going Down are halved rounding down. If able to fire both HE and Anti-tank, when firing from Ambush, must specify which round is loaded. D3 Pin Markers, +2 PEN, Hits vs targets in buildings D6

sharedRules.name: HE (3")
sharedRules.description: Use the appropriate template to determine how many models in the unit have been hit. Hits against infantry that reacts going Down are halved rounding down. If able to fire both HE and Anti-tank, when firing from Ambush, must specify which round is loaded. D3 Pin Markers, +3 PEN, Hits vs targets in buildings 2D6

sharedRules.name: HE (4")
sharedRules.description: Use the appropriate template to determine how many models in the unit have been hit. Hits against infantry that reacts going Down are halved rounding down. If able to fire both HE and Anti-tank, when firing from Ambush, must specify which round is loaded. D6 Pin Markers, +4 PEN, Hits vs targets in buildings 3D6

sharedRules.name: Heavy Frontal Armour
sharedRules.description: The frontal armour is considered to be on the next value on the armour category.

sharedRules.name: Howitzer
sharedRules.description: When firing over open sights it has no minimum range. When firing indirect, it have a minimum range.

sharedRules.name: Indirect Fire
sharedRules.description: Can target only units without minimum range. Requires 6 to hit on first attempt: -1 for each successive attempt if firer and target have not moved. If a hit is scored, all further attempts are at 2+. Can target enemy units even if friends are in the way, as long as it has line of sight. When firing at vehicles hits top armour and adds +1 PEN and +1 to Damage Rolls. Cannot be given Ambush orders. Can fire Smoke Screens.

sharedRules.name: Low Velocity
sharedRules.description: Low velocity light AT-gun's armour penetration counts as +3 instead of +4.

sharedRules.name: Massive shells
sharedRules.description: Does not suffer -1 penetration penalty when shooting at targets at over half range.

sharedRules.name: Medical vehicle
sharedRules.description: Being in proximity of an ambulance means that any wounded soldiers neaby hae a chance of being treated by a medic or stretcher bearer from amongst the crew of the ambulance. All infantry and artillery units within 6" of the vehicle count as within 6" of a medic.

sharedRules.name: Motorbikes
sharedRules.description: A motorbike unit moves at 12” at an Advance and 24” at a Run. Troops cannot remount once dismounted. Bike riders can shoot only when stationary. Can regroup with a 2D6” move. Can react with an escape move.

sharedRules.name: Multiple Launcher
sharedRules.description:
Counts as a heavy mortar, hits only with a 6 (no ranging in). Every time you fire it, pick the
first target unit as normal and then check which other enemy units are within 6” of the original template, these are also targets. If there is a friendly unit within 6” of the original template, you cannot fire and the shot is wasted. Once the target units have been determined, check if any of these units are within the minimum range, these units are missed automatically. Then roll to hit for all remaining target units, one at a time in any order you prefer, hitting on 6. If you score one or more hits, work out the total of all of the hits inflicted by the salvo on target units, using the relevant templates, and then proceed to roll to damage.

sharedRules.name: One-man turret
sharedRules.description: The vehicle needs to pass an order test when issued an Advance order.

sharedRules.name: One-Shot Weapon
sharedRules.description: The weapon can be shoot only once per game and also at a different target than the rest of the unit.

sharedRules.name: Open Topped
sharedRules.description: Can be pinned by small arms fire. If damaged by assaulting infantry, open topped vehicle are destroyed automatically. If hit by indirect HE fire, add +1 to PEN and +1 to damage rolls.

sharedRules.name: Recce
sharedRules.description: The vehicle can reverse at their full Advance rate. If fired at or assaulted and it has not taken an order it can attempt to escape with a movement up full Advance rate away from the enemy.

sharedRules.name: Reinforced Rear Armour
sharedRules.description: Hits against the rear armour counts as hits against the side armour (i.e. +1 penetration instead of +2 penetration).

sharedRules.name: Shaped Charge
sharedRules.description: Never suffer -1 penalty at penetration for firing at long range.

sharedRules.name: Shirkers
sharedRules.description: Must always take an order test when given an order, even if not Pinned. When Pinned always count Pinned Markers as Double, ie one Pin Marker gives a -2 penalty, 2 is -4 etc.

sharedRules.name: Slow
sharedRules.description: Can only move 6" when Advancing and 12" when Running

sharedRules.name: Sniper
sharedRules.description: Only when firing under Fire or Ambush orders range is 36", minimum range is 12". Can target a specific model as per Exceptional Damage rule. Ignores negative to-hit modifiers exept pins and missing assisant.

sharedRules.name: Squeeze Bore
sharedRules.description: At ranges up to 12", it's base armour penetration is increased by 2, at over half range armour penetration is reduced by 2 instead of the normal 1.

sharedRules.name: Tank Hunters
sharedRules.description: No Tank Fear test is required when assaulting tanks. If a tank hunter unit wins an assault and scores damage against an armoured vehicle, the effect is resolved on the damage result table as for a normal anti-tank penetration.

sharedRules.name: Team Weapon
sharedRules.description: A minimum of two crew is required to fire at full effect. If only one crew is left, fires at -1 to hit.

sharedRules.name: Turn on the spot
sharedRules.description: Can execute a full speed Run rate 'reverse', finishing the move facing in the direction of travel.

sharedRules.name: Unreliable
sharedRules.description: If this vehicle suffers one or more pin markers as a result of an enemy attack it automatically suffers one further pin marker in addition.

sharedRules.name: Weak Side Armour
sharedRules.description: All shots to the side of the vehicle have an additional +1 penetration modifier.

sharedRules.name: Armoured Platoon
sharedRules.description: The Armoured Platoon must include enough transport vehicles and/or tows (either soft-skin or armoured) to transport all models in the infantry and artillery units in the platoon, up to a maximum of one transport vehicle per unit of Infantry and /or Artillery.  The only units that are an exception to this, and which cannot have a transport vehicle are mounted cavalry units and units on motorcycles.

sharedRules.name: ARVs and Force Selection
sharedRules.description: Yo may include up to one ARV in your army for every two non-ARV vehicles of damage value 8 or greater you have.

sharedRules.name: Stubborn
sharedRules.description: If forced to take a morale check, the unit ignore negative morale modifiers from pin markers. Remember that order tests are not morale checks.

sharedRules.name: Tough Fighters
sharedRules.description: When a model scores a casualty in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can immediately make a second damage roll.

sharedRules.name: Ski troops
sharedRules.description: Ignore winter movement penality.

sharedRules.name: Vulnerable
sharedRules.description: All shots to the side and rear have a +1 penetration modifier.

sharedRules.name: Gyro-stabilisers
sharedRules.description: A veteran vehicle ignore -1 penalty to shoot when issued an Advance order.

sharedRules.name: Flamethrower Assistant
sharedRules.description: For every Flamethrower purchased for the squad, another member becomes the assistant.

sharedRules.name: Armoured Skirts
sharedRules.description: Anti-tank rifles and shaped charges never recieve the +1 penetration bonus for hitting the vehicle in the side.

sharedRules.name: Behind Enemy Lines
sharedRules.description: When Outflanking infantry ignores the -1 modifier to the Order test for coming onto the table.

sharedRules.name: Easily Catches Fire
sharedRules.description: If a roll on the vehicle damage table results in the vehicle catching fire add D3 pin markers rather than just 1 before taking a morale test.

sharedRules.name: Transport
sharedRules.description: The vehicle can transport troops.

sharedRules.name: Dog Mine
sharedRules.description:
A dog mine is a one-shot weapon with a range of 18". Dog mines can only target stationary vehicles (i.e. any vehicle that is not sporting an order dice showing  Run or Advance order).  Dog mines are fired as normal, except instead of rolling a die to hit, you roll on the following chart. Note that if a Recce vehicle reacts to the dog mine attack by moving, the dog mine automatically scores a 2-3.

1 The dog hits the closes friendly stationary vehicle within range instead of the target. Resolve as a hit 4-6 below. If no target presents, see 2-3 below. 

2-3 The dog is either gunned down or bolts from the noise of battle and deserts, possibly lured by the smell of German sausages. The traitor will be shot on sight by political officers. 

4-6 The dog scampers to the target, crawls underneat and explodes. The vehicle suffers a hit with a Pen of +5. (No Pen modifiers apply)

sharedRules.name: Experimental
sharedRules.description: Experimental tanks must pass an order test whenever they are given an order, even when they have no Pin markers on them.

sharedRules.name: Get back in the fight!
sharedRules.description: If any unit fails an attempt to rally it can immediately roll a second attempt if within 6” of a military police squad.

sharedRules.name: Traffic Direction
sharedRules.description: If your force includes a military police squad in reserve it does not suffer the -1 penalty for attempting to bring vehicles onto the table.

sharedRules.name: AT Shell
sharedRules.description: Can fire AT shell with a Pen value of +4.

sharedRules.name: Mountaineers
sharedRules.description: This unit will treat all rough ground as open ground. The players should discuss and agree before the game if the gaming table includes some terrain that they think this rule should not apply to, like water features and other terrain elements that obviously mountain troops would have no advantage in crossing.

sharedRules.name: Motivated Elite
sharedRules.description: This unit removes D2 pins rather than one for passing order tests.

sharedRules.name: Tough as old boots
sharedRules.description: This unit rolls bonus attack dice when fighting at close quarters. For every 3 men fighting in the combat roll one extra die.

sharedRules.name: Cavalry Carbines
sharedRules.description: These rifles count as pistols while mounted; and rifles when used on foot.

sharedRules.name: Loader
sharedRules.description: For every special weapon purchased for the squad (LMG, Mortar, Flamethrower, etc), another member becomes the loader.

sharedRules.name: Unarmed
sharedRules.description: Unarmed men neither shoot nor attack in close quarters, their only value is as casualties.

sharedRules.name: Slow Load
sharedRules.description: A vehicle can not be given an order until at least a unit on the same side has already been given orders.

sharedRules.name: 75MM AT-gun
sharedRules.description: The vehicle shoot HE(2") instead of HE(1") shells.

sharedRules.name: Bangalore Torpedoes
sharedRules.description: To use bangalore torpedoes the unit must start the turn within 2" to the target then Advance at least 2" further away from it. Roll 2D6, with 6 or more hits the obstacle is destroyed.

sharedRules.name: Demolition Chargers
sharedRules.description: To use demolition charges the unit must start the turn adiacent to the target then Advance at least 4" avay from it. All units in a 4" radius(bukers and dug in units 2") are hit with a +4 pen. (HE 4"), 3D6 to blow up buildings.

sharedRules.name: Forward Deploy
sharedRules.description: This unit count as observers/snipers the set-up purpose.

sharedRules.name: Lone Sniper
sharedRules.description: As it does not have the team weapon rule, the sniper does not suffer the -1 to hit for not having a spotter.

sharedRules.name: Engineers
sharedRules.description: Count as engineers in scenarios where barbed wire and minefield special rules are used.

sharedRules.name: Motorised Infantry
sharedRules.description: The squad can re-roll any failed order test that is required to mount or dismount a transport vehicle.

sharedRules.name: Assault
sharedRules.description: This weapon suffers no penalty ‘to hit’ when moving and shooting. In addition, infantry models armed with an assault weapon count as tough fighters.

sharedRules.name: Spotter
sharedRules.description: The spotter forms part of the same unit as the weapon he is directing, no separate order die is provided for him. then the crew are assumed to be able to see whatever the spotter can see. Inexperienced spotters can not spot for the weapon they are attached to.

sharedRules.name: Medics
sharedRules.description: If a friendly infantry or artillery unit that has a medic model within 6”, suffers damage from small-arms fire, one die is rolled for each point of damage caused. On a 6, that casualty is ignored.

sharedRules.name: Morale bonus
sharedRules.description: Officer model adds a morale bonus to all friendly units dependng on it's rank.

sharedRules.name: You men snap into action
sharedRules.description: When an officer receives an order successfully it can activate a number of units depending on it's rank.

sharedRules.name: Frontal Armour
sharedRules.description: This vehicle cannot be damaged by small arms hits from the frontal arc but will still be pinned as normal.

sharedRules.name: Rally to the Colours!
sharedRules.description: All friendly infantry and artillery units within 12” of the flag-bearing model can re-roll failed Order tests when ordered to Rally. In addition, if the Rally Order is successfully issued, the unit rolls two dice to determine how many pin markers are discarded and chooses the highest result. However, while the unit carry ing the flag has a Down or Ambush order dice on it, the flag is kept hidden and has no effect.

sharedRules.name: Flags
sharedRules.description: Japanese and Soviet infantry squads (not teams!) in all theatres and periods have the following equipment option: One man can replace all of his weapons with a flag for +25pts, gaining the Rally to the Colours! special rule.

sharedRules.name: Tough Tank Hunters
sharedRules.description: Tough tank hunters have all the usual rules for Tank Hunters, and in addition double their attaks in close combat against vehicles (i.e., each solidier makes two attaks)

sharedRules.name: Versatile (Light Howitzer)
sharedRules.description: Can also fire as a light howitzer.

sharedRules.name: Mountain Warriors
sharedRules.description: An infantry section can scale mountainous of hilly impassable terrain. To do this they must start their turn adjacent to the impassable terrain piece. They are then given the Run order and the squad is polaced on top of the mountain or hill. If the terrain piece is higher than 6" tall it takes the section two turns to scale it. At the end of the first turn of movement up the terrain piece, leave the unit's Order die next to them showing the Run order. At the start of the next turn(before Order dice are pulled) place the unit at the top, leaving the run order die next to them. In addition , Mountain Warriors may make a run move through rough ground. This run move is reduced to a maximum distance of 9".

sharedRules.name: Recon Troops
sharedRules.description: The unit will spot hidden enemy units at 18" rather than the normal 12".

sharedRules.name: Extra Selection
sharedRules.description: You may take up to 3 of this unit as 1 selection in each reinforced platoon.

sharedRules.name: Split fire
sharedRules.description: This weapon can fire at a different target from the rest of the squad

sharedRules.name: Hitler's Buzzsaw
sharedRules.description: German-made machine guns, but in particular the lethal MG42, are vastly superior to their enemies’ and rightly feared by Allied infantrymen. German light and medium machine guns fire one extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and machine guns, both those carried by infantry units and vehiclemounted ones.

rules.name: Lance
rules.description: Units equipped with lances gain one aditional attack in close quarters, but may not fire their carbines while mounted. Lances are discarded if the unit dismounts.

selectionEntries.name: Reduce morale bonus distance from 12" to 6" (Lack of Radios)
